rationale: Started 2026-11-10T08:19:02Z; ended 2026-11-10T08:34:20Z (UTC). I did not produce this decision. Every source_fingerprints file re-hashed to its pinned digest, each checked record's text_path re-hashed to its text_sha256, and each quoted text equals the exact char_start:char_end slice of its held file. I read the original in full (24 FR 3777): EO 10816 of May 7, 1959 only amends EO 10501, adding Sec. 4(i) on declassification by agencies without original classification authority, adding a historical-research access rule to Sec. 15, and rewriting the first sentence of Sec. 8(d); identity is confirmed and it has no free-standing command. The held FR text of EO 11652 (37 FR 5209, Mar. 8, 1972) says in Sec. 14 that EO 10501 as amended by EO 10816 and later orders is superseded as of the effective date of this order, and Sec. 15 makes that June 1, 1972, so nothing of EO 10816 survived to 2026-10-14 and status no holds. Qualification for the lifecycle record: the statement that no earlier end was found is wrong for two items. The held FR and APP texts of EO 10964 (Sept. 20, 1961) delete paragraph (i) of Sec. 4 (re-enacting its substance as 4(h)) and rewrite Sec. 8(d), so items 1 and 3 ended 1961-09-20 and only item 2 ran to June 1, 1972; this does not change the whole-order status.
